fields.title: 📖 Athar refutation: Bidʿah is not to be minimized
fields.body:
🖋️ **al-Barbahārī** said:

> ***“al-Barbahārī said in meaning: Beware of small innovations, for small innovations grow until they become great.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** This statement refutes the downplaying of bidʿah. What begins small can draw the heart, step by step, away from the Sunnah.

immutable.source: 📝 al-Barbahārī, Sharḥ as-Sunnah, Warnung vor kleinen Neuerungen.
